raw_segments.text: Well, then, cook, you see this whale steak of yours was so very bad that I have put it
out of sight as soon as possible.
Well, for the future, when you cook another whale steak for my private table here, the
capstan, I'll tell you what to do so as not to spoil it by overdoing.
Hold the steak in one hand and show a live coal to it with the other.
And now tomorrow, cook, when we are cutting in the fish, be sure you stand by to get the
tips of his fins, have them put in pickle.
As for the ends of the flukes, have them soused, cook.
